text: Conceded: 18-38 words/page is the 5-6 band only; 3-4 is already 6 pages x 10-24, and two of the five pilot books were placed at 3-4, so the gap is smaller than my proposal implied. Five books from one programme cannot justify an L-sized rework. I withdraw engine work and back content-library's cheaper route (a turn marker inside existing variants) as a sandbox idea, to be re-tested when the corpus has >=10 books from >=2 sources.
